description: This file provides utility functions for handling timestamps, including conversion to date strings and formatting for MySQL compatibility, for the 'repo_diff' project.

methods.name: TimestampSeconds
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp as a RepoTimestamp.

methods.name: TimestampToDate
methods.description: Converts a RepoTimestamp to a date string in YYYY-MM-DD format.

methods.name: TimestampToDataStudioDatetime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a string suitable for MySQL datetime, concatenating year, month, day, and hour.
